flagstone_sentry_1.m: Halt! Who's there? No one is allowed to approach Flagstone.

flagstone_sentry_10.m: So, here we are. I have to guard the road from undead, so that they do not spread farther than Flagstone.

flagstone_sentry_11.m: So, I would advise you to leave unless you want to be overrun by undead.
r: Can I investigate the Flagstone ruins?

flagstone_sentry_12.m: Are you really sure you want to head in there? Well, OK, fine by me.

flagstone_sentry_13.m: I won't stop you, and I won't mourn you if you never return.

flagstone_sentry_14.m: Go ahead. Let me know if there's anything I can tell you that would help.

flagstone_sentry_15.m: Return here if you need my advice.
r: OK. I will return to you if there is anything I need help with.

flagstone_sentry_2.m: You should turn back while you still can.

flagstone_sentry_20.m: A guardian and undead prisoners you say? This is troubling news, since it means there is some larger force behind all this.

flagstone_sentry_21.m: You should look for the former warden. Maybe he has something to do with all of this. If you find him you should return here with any important news.
r: OK, I will go and look for the former warden.

flagstone_sentry_23.m: Oh this looks most interesting. Let's take a look. Hmm. It has got some weird inscriptions on it that say 'Daylight Shadow'. Maybe you could try these words on the demon? So perhaps the warden did have something to do with the demon after all?

flagstone_sentry_3.m: Flagstone has been overrun by undead, and we are standing guard here to make sure no undead escape.
r: Can you tell me the story about Flagstone?

flagstone_sentry_4.m: Flagstone Prison was built a few hundred years ago by house Gorland of Stoutford and used until the Noble Wars, when the house was vanquished. This dreadful place has been abandoned ever since.

flagstone_sentry_43.m: Well, keep looking. Return to me if you need my advice.

flagstone_sentry_45.m: This is both good and bad news. I am truly grateful that you rid us of the warden and his thralls. Talk to Yolgen for a reward. We will make sure that we recover this prisoner.
r: Thank you. Shadow be with you.

flagstone_sentry_8.m: For years, no one took notice of Flagstone, although there were occasional reports from travelers of terrible screams coming from the camp.

flagstone_sentry_9.m: But recently, undead started pouring out of Flagstone and started to threaten Stoutford and the trade routes nearby.

flagstone_sentry_return1.m: Hello again. Did you enter Flagstone? I am surprised you actually returned.
r: Can you tell me the story again?
There is a guardian in the lower levels of Flagstone that cannot be approached and the former prisoners are undead now.

flagstone_sentry_return2.m: Hello again. Have you found the former warden in Flagstone yet?
r: I slew the former warden and found a peculiar necklace among his remains.
Can you tell me the story again?
Not yet. I have to keep looking.

flagstone_sentry_return3.m: Hello again. How is the investigation of the undead in Flagstone going?

flagstone_sentry_return4.m: Hello again. It seems something happened inside Flagstone that made the undead weaker. I'm sure we have you to thank for it.
r: In the depths of Flagstone, I had to fight a winged demon and found a prisoner called Narael. He told me that he has been there for a very long time, and is too weak to leave.

flagstone.5: Yolgen asked me to have a look at what is wrong with Flagstone prison.
flagstone.10: I met a guard from Stoutford on sentry duty outside a fortress called Flagstone. He told me that Flagstone used to serve as a prison for house Gorland of Stoutford, but it is now abandoned. Recently, undead have started pouring out of Flagstone. I should investigate the source of the undead monsters. The guard tells me to return to him if I need help.
flagstone.20: I found a dug out tunnel beneath Flagstone, that seems to lead to a larger cave. The cave is guarded by a demon that I am not even able to approach. Maybe the guard outside Flagstone knows more?
flagstone.30: The guard suggested that the former warden may have something to do with this, and I should go and look for him. If I find him I should return to the guard with any important news.
flagstone.31: I found the former warden of Flagstone on the upper level. Among his remains I found a necklace with some inscriptions. I should return to the guard now.
flagstone.40: I have learned the words required to approach the demon beneath Flagstone. 'Daylight Shadow'. It seems like the warden has something to do with the monster invasion.
flagstone.50: Deep beneath Flagstone, I found a powerful winged demon. It seems like the warden kept on running the prison and experimented with necromancy.
flagstone.60: I found one prisoner, Narael, alive deep beneath Flagstone. Narael was once a citizen of Nor City. He is too weak to walk by himself, but if I can find his wife in Nor City, I would be handsomely rewarded.
flagstone.70: I approached the sentry again and he was happy to hear the source of the undead is gone. I should talk to Yolgen, the priest of Stoutford, for a reward.
flagstone.100: Yolgen rewarded me handsomely for my efforts and is happy that there is one thing less the citizens of Stoutford have to worry about.

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
